title: Insecure permissions in ProjectMAXS MAXS Main v0.5.19 (versionCode 19) allows unauthorized attackers to arbitrarily…
description: ProjectMAXS MAXS Main version 0.5.19 (versionCode 19) contains insecure permissions that allow unauthorized attackers to arbitrarily manipulate the app's MAXS command and transport mechanism. This vulnerability could enable attackers to interfere with the app's internal communication or control flows.
